resources.string: This app needs Usage Access to help you track your time effectively. Please grant this permission in the system settings.

If you want to remove your information please click the button below to delete all the data you generated using the application.\nNote this action is final. Data cannot be restored. If you wish to resume participation in the study, you will have to consent again with none of your prior data saved.\nTo delete the researchers\' copy of the information submitted via the Google Form at the start of the study or ending survey/interview data, contact Teal Amore at tamore@emich.edu.

Are you sure you want to delete all your data associated with this Participant ID? This withdraws your consent, stops data collection, and erases study data on this device and on our servers. You will need to consent again to keep using the app. This action cannot be undone.

Welcome to KTHD. Before using this application, please review and accept our consent agreement.

This application collects background usage metrics and active task durations to assist in tracking productivity and focus. Your data is associated with your unique Participant ID and stored securely.

Participation is completely voluntary. You may withdraw consent at any time by uninstalling the application.

By tapping "Agree & Continue", you confirm that you have read and agreed to the terms of this study.
